timing_note: 84 arms on 28 workers. The 56 ReLU arms (~80-320 s) run in about two waves, so all 28 SwiGLU h2 r16, headslow r16 and h2 r8 arms start by about 640 s. Even at the full 1990 s per-arm cap they finish by about 2630 s, about 970 s under the 3600 s global cap. No arm is expected to be cut by the global cap; that would need ReLU arms averaging above about 800 s. SwiGLU arms may still reach their own 1990 s per-arm cap and are kept as censored outcomes.

Neither validate() nor validate_protocol rejects extra unlisted files under code/, diagnostics/ or swiglu/ (inherited behaviour). The file sets matched the reference at review time, so dispatch the committed leaf unmodified.
